title: Events and tickets
summary: Sell tickets, welcome attendees and check each ticket in once. Owners manage events and door staff; attendees see only their own tickets.

entryPoints.summary: Browse public events and ticket types.
Sign in or create an attendee account.
See only your orders and ticket codes.
Manage events, ticket types, categories, staff, imports and attendee exports.
Check in one ticket code once.
Set a new password with a one-time proof.

owner.summary: Manages events, staff, categories and outside refund records.

door.summary: Signs in to check tickets in; no attendee lists or management access.

member.summary: An attendee: signs up at checkout and sees only their own tickets.

visitor.summary: Browses public event pages and sign-in.

journeys.summary: Creates an event in its local time zone and opens ticket sales.
Adds an event category and removes it when unused.
Signs up at checkout and reserves a free ticket.
Browses public events without signing in.
Opens the owner settings through a one-use pass.
Explains the email requirement for password recovery.
Pays in test mode; tickets issue only after the server verifies captured payment.
Receives ticket codes through the email module after confirming the address.
Needs a refund-create capability. Complete refunds outside the app, then record them.
Checks in a code once and refuses its second use.
journeys.reason: The random ticket code must be taken from an attendee session; scripts/walk.mjs proves both scans with separate authenticated browsers.
The trusted checklist cannot inspect downloaded CSV bytes; database tests and scripts/walk.mjs read the export.

journeys.summary: Imports event rows from a CSV file.

notIncluded: Payment and email modules are off by default; payment connections must be configured for test mode. No live paid calls were made.
Refund creation is unavailable. The owner records a completed outside refund with a note before paid seats release.
Late payments after an expired or cancelled hold require organiser review and an outside refund; no ticket is issued.
Ticket emails and password recovery need a confirmed email address and a configured sender.
Going live requires the platform live database, which is off by default.
Attendees cannot change their password while signed in.
One ticket type per order, up to ten tickets. Door check-in accepts pasted codes; camera scanning is not included.
Lists are bounded: 500 events, 100 attendee orders, 1000 tickets and 10000 attendee export rows.
